What I do
3 pillars.
One focus.

I work where revenue, deployment and relationships meet. The job isn't just closing the contract — it's building the engine that makes the next contract easier.

01 / CLOSE

Custom AI projects

At Morpheuslabs.io, I work across the full custom AI project cycle — understanding the client’s systems and processes, spotting the gaps, shaping prototypes and requirements, and carrying the deal through delivery. I also stay close after the sale, making sure the solution is delivered well, the client is satisfied, and the relationship continues beyond the project. Good delivery builds trust, and trust often leads to repeat business, referrals and new opportunities.

02 / GROW

Build product revenue

For Quicksales.ai, the WhatsApp AI Agent we built in-house, I work across sales, onboarding, conversion and retention to build recurring revenue. Because I’m close to the customers, I collect feedback firsthand and work closely with the tech team to turn that feedback into product improvements. I also help identify and push forward the features, processes and priorities needed to move an early-stage SaaS product from an idea into something customers keep using.

03 / BUILD

Partnerships network

Chambers, trade associations, cloud vendors, government agenciesand businesses across industries. I've built and maintain a wide and strong partner network — through joint events, warm introductions, cross-referrals, co-marketing, and a genuine exchange of value with each partner.

ABOUT ME
Building relationships.Fueling Growth. Creating Impact.

I've started and run a few small businesses since young — F&B, motor vehicles, interior design, and ecommerce. I enjoy the process of turning an idea into something real, and I'm happiest when I'm hands-on, executing and learning as I go.

I genuinely love networking and meeting new people. Every conversation teaches me something new, and many of these relationships turn into long-term partnerships that create real impact.

I'm obsessed with tech and AI. Always an early adopter — from Web3, Crypto and NFTs to the latest tools and platforms. I experiment, break things, learn fast, and share what I learn.

Claude is my coworker. I taught myself to vibe-code — this very website included — and now I lean on AI for research and ideation as much as for automating the boring parts of my own work. I believe the best way to grow is by building.

With the rise of AI, I'm more excited than ever about the next 5 years. None of this happens alone — I've been fortunate to learn from good mentors and to have the room to grow, and I try to stay just as open to learning something new today as I was on day one. Always happy to connect and see where we can build something together.

Build. Connect. Experiment. Keep growing.
